ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #6
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

2. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

3. Which response best shows understanding of My extended family? (1 mark)
   A. Say My extended family has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of My extended family with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use My extended family to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My extended family.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Names of Scriptures able to:? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Names of Scriptures able to:.
   B. Apply the teaching of Names of Scriptures able to: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Names of Scriptures able to: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Names of Scriptures able to: has no place in daily life.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of? (1 mark)
   A. Say Pillars of has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Pillars of with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Pillars of to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of.

6. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Cheating in exams

7. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in His? (1 mark)
   A. Use Belief in His to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in His.
   C. Apply the teaching of Belief in His with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Belief in His has no place in daily life.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Manners of? (1 mark)
   A. Say Manners of has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Manners of with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Manners of.
   D. Use Manners of to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Relationship? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Relationship.
   B. Say Relationship has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Relationship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Relationship to insult classmates of other faiths.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Surah Naas? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Surah Naas with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Surah Naas has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Surah Naas.
   D. Use Surah Naas to insult classmates of other faiths.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic? (1 mark)
   A. Say Islamic has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Islamic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Islamic to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic.

12. Which response best shows understanding of The Arabic? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Arabic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Arabic.
   C. Say The Arabic has no place in daily life.
   D. Use The Arabic to insult classmates of other faiths.

13. Which response best shows understanding of The Enlightened Beings able to:? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Enlightened Beings able to: has no place in daily life.
   B. Use The Enlightened Beings able to: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Enlightened Beings able to: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Enlightened Beings able to:.

14. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in.
   B. Use Belief in to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Belief in with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Belief in has no place in daily life.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
